meta.title: Superagent WSL local adapter
meta.description: Local experimental adaptation of the upstream research prototype: manage GitHub tickets on a Windows Host and run commands and workspaces in a selected WSL distribution. Requires an account and allowed list; Feishu is not enabled. Targets DSH 0.2.2-rc.3 and WSL workspace 0.7.13; see the bundled WSL-ADAPTER document for verification limits.
